probes.a: does the promotion path re-verify the GATE-TIME seals and RECOMPUTE totality before the artifacts land?
probes.b: is the transcript reconciled with the ledger by content — its PASS lines parsed back and compared against the gate rows?
probes.c: are the wall patterns semantic (regex, case-folded) with a positive leg, rather than literal strings?
probes.d: is a verbatim anchor's text CONSUMED — read back out of the anchor registry by a gate predicate?
probes.e: are claims, tables and fences gated by EQUALITY in both directions rather than containment or a floor?
probes.f: is there a sentence-level referent binding, per occurrence, over prose only?
probes.g: how many numerals are TYPED into published gate statements rather than interpolated from a live registry?
probes.h: how many falsifier hooks poison a verdict variable (a constant boolean, a constant append) instead of a measurement?
probes.i: is the read set recorded where reads happen (an audit hook or an open wrapper) rather than inside one helper?
